text:
nina (product): Quick thread for TenantOpt pilot request from HealthApps — they want tenant-level opt-in, per-tenant canary slices, and an auditor CSV export. Need a playbook we can hand to Customer Security.

diego (eng): Short answer: doable with current flag infra. We'll use flag variants: shadow, canary, ramp. Important: cache keying per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant cache leaks.

mei (sre): Gate ideas: latency_p95 delta <= +20ms, error_rate delta <= +0.15%, and a token-usage cost cap. If any gate trips for that tenant -> immediate rollback for that tenant only. We should also enforce a 1-hour cooldown after rollback.

lara (sales): HealthApps timeline = 4 weeks. They want a visible opt-in toggle in their admin and a CSV export endpoint. Also asked for contact for incident escalation.

sam (legal): CSV export needs field whitelist and retention duration. We must hash user IDs before export and include a signature field for audit. Also confirm consent in DPA addendum.

diego (eng): Proposed minimal rollout sequence: 1) shadow 72h (no billing) with traces, 2) tenant canary 5% for 24h, 3) 25% for 24h, 4) 100%. We'll attach `billing_label` only at active stage.

mei (sre): Ops reqs: runbook entry, PD escalation route, and an alert that auto-triggers when a tenant exceeds cost cap so we can flip billing_hold.

nina (product): Decision: ship templated manual playbook for now (low dev cost). If we get >3 customers asking, scope GA work for tenant routing and per-tenant quotas. Track ops hours per rollout.

lara (sales): I'll confirm HealthApps accepts manual CSV for first pilot and will collect tenant IDs this week.

diego (eng): Implementation snippet (flag JSON) to share with SRE/legal:
```json
{"flag":"tenantopt-healthapps","variants":["shadow","canary","active"],"slices":["0%","5%","25%","100%"],"tenant_scope":"healthapps_tenant_id"}
```

mei (sre): Add to that: observability sink and S3 path for export e.g. `s3://audits/healthapps/cutover/` and retention policy note.

sam (legal): I'll draft the privacy addendum and hash spec. 48h ETA.

ops-bot: CI: feature-flag branch tests passed. No infra blockers detected.

nina (product): Action items: Diego PRD + sample flag by EOD tomorrow, Mei runbook + alert rules in 48h, Sam DPA draft in 48h, Lara confirm tenant IDs and pilot acceptance. We'll reconvene next Tue. Keep updates here.
